name: heap-arena-replay
description: Replays a malloc/free/realloc trace on a word-accurate simulated heap (boundary tags, prologue/epilogue, explicit and segregated free lists) under first-fit, next-fit, best-fit and worst-fit, with policy switching mid-replay, side-by-side comparison, a simulator-verified quiz generator with Canvas QTI export, and a diff mode for student allocator traces. Entirely client-side.
